summary: A single-player 5v5 Cipher Breach vertical slice on the original map Aperture Annex: an in-browser 64 Hz authoritative room with a full economy, 12 weapons, 5 utility types, arm/disarm, halftime and overtime, perception-limited bots, a Practice range, and a match-end analysis screen.
notes: Single-player only: the authoritative room runs in-page and there is no network transport, matchmaking or services. Bots are attacker-favoured (~65-75% of rounds). The main screenshot uses the URL-gated harness autopilot (?harness=1&autopilot=1) so a live engagement is on camera.
